_source: palette.py of the MOXIR scenes-50 job, 2026-10-15; hexes sampled from the teasers in palette-teasers-moxir-2026-10-15.json; saturation S in the rule is taste, UNVALIDATED

palette.name: ash
palette.role: the warm white: blinders, the key on the DJ

palette.name: ember
palette.measured: ours; t4 laser fans: 66 % of saturated glow is red (sampled #dd0001)
palette.role: the red peak only: act 3, the risers, act 5 hits

palette.name: deep ember
palette.practice: monochrome red as a tool (Moody & Dexter)

palette.name: cold white
palette.measured: t8 hangar: 22 % of the glow clusters (sampled #eefdfd)
palette.practice: Berlin techno's white beam/strobe room (Denk & von Thülen 2012)
palette.role: act 1 and the act 5 white-out, strobes

palette.name: steel blue
palette.practice: Purkinje shift: blue-green reads brighter in the dark (CIE 1951 scotopic V'(λ), peak 507 nm)
palette.role: act 1 walls and floor, the way out

palette.name: poster green
palette.measured: t1/t2 poster: 20 % of lit pixels (#37743d); saturated glow is 100 % green (median #74a97b)
palette.role: act 2: the hall turns the poster

palette.name: poster glow
palette.measured: t1/t2 poster: 33 % of the glow clusters (sampled #f4fcf4), the light column

palette.name: laser green
palette.rule: diode green (532 nm DPSS / 520 nm diode), lasers only
palette.measured: t5 rave: 29 % green + 52 % cyan of saturated glow (laser lines through haze, #6fa98d)
palette.practice: acid house green (M. Collin, Altered State, 1997)

palette.name: deep blue
palette.measured: t4 laser reference: 15 % of glow (#3f45bc), 22 % of saturated glow is blue
palette.practice: the breakdown cool-down (Butler 2006: breakdown as release)

palette.name: UV violet
palette.measured: t7: 28 % of saturated glow violet (#6228bb); t4: 6 % (#9662c8)
palette.practice: black light in rave culture (S. Reynolds, Energy Flash, 1998)
palette.role: act 3 with red, act 4 with blue

palette.name: amber
palette.measured: t8: 13 % of saturated glow amber (#c9a57b); t6: 13 % (#b69656)
palette.practice: sodium street light outside a factory (589 nm); amber only as warmth
palette.role: warmth only: the road at doors and at the end

palette.name: petrol
palette.measured: t5 rave: cyan is 52 % of the saturated glow (median #6ea9ab), the laser lines through haze
palette.practice: teal / blue-green gels (LEE 116 Medium Blue-Green, Rosco R95 Medium Blue Green); blue-green sits by the 507 nm peak of night vision, so it reads brightest in the dark (CIE 1951 V'(λ); mesopic photometry CIE 191:2010)
palette.role: the act 4 floor; teal accents in acts 1-3

palette.name: ice
palette.measured: t8 hangar: 26 % of the glow (#b4c8d4), the cold beam columns
palette.practice: cold-tinted white: LEE 218 Eighth CTB / LEE 203 Quarter CTB; the white rooms of Berlin techno (Denk & von Thülen 2012)
palette.role: the act 1 floor and the end of act 5; ice rays; the act 5 strobe

palette.name: lavender
palette.measured: t4 laser reference: 13.3 % of the glow (#9982d4), the pale violet round the red fans
palette.practice: LEE 136 Pale Lavender / LEE 170 Deep Lavender; replaces saturated UV on the lamps (the beams' wheel already showed Lavender for UV)
palette.role: the peaks' violet (acts 3 and 5), the act 5 floor

palette.name: mint
palette.measured: t5 rave: green is 28.6 % of the saturated glow (median #6fa98d); the poster's pale glow #cfe5d0 (t1/t2, 12.4 %) is the same family
palette.practice: the poster's green made soft; no single gel matches (taste)

palette.name: rose-copper
palette.measured: t5 rave: 2.3 % of the glow (#ad756c), warm haze; the hall's own rust (t3 #a08c81) returns warm light best (measured)
palette.practice: a warm that is not red: copper/rose tints instead of ember (taste); WCAG 2.2: not a saturated red (R share < 0.8)
palette.role: the act 3 floor; the warm accent where v2 had red

palette.name: deep sea
palette.measured: t5 rave: blue median of the saturated glow #73a0b4; t8: 84 % of the saturated glow is blue (#7492af)
palette.practice: a cyan-blue (~480 nm dominant), not the 450 nm end of pure blue the eye cannot bring into focus (Thibos et al. 1992)
palette.role: act 4 rays and plane: the blue that is not pure blue

palette.name: warm white
palette.rule: Planckian 3200 K (Kim et al. 2002 spline, IEC 61966-2-1 sRGB)
palette.measured: t5 rave: 25.6 % of the glow is warm white (#dbd9cf)
palette.practice: tungsten 3200 K: LEE 204 Full CTO turns daylight into it; the classic stage key
palette.role: the key and kicker on the DJ, the afterglow

palette.name: lavender (beams)
palette.rule: the wheel slot's own hex (Lavender, assumed Sharpy order, di.iiii assumedProfiles.js)
palette.measured: same hue family as lavender (t4 #9982d4); the washes' lavender #b699ff would snap to CTB 8000 (greenish) on the wheel, so the beams carry the slot's hex
